ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_logmeanexp_loss_scaled_advantage
ir.intuition: Modified the original pairwise advantage logmeanexp loss by scaling the margin with sigmoid-normalized advantage_gap to weight the loss dynamically by how informative each pair is. This reduces uniform weighting, increases focus on meaningful pairs with higher advantage gap, and introduces soft-normalization improving stability and learning signal richness. Also replaced direct weighting with this advantage-based dynamic scaling to reduce redundancy and differentiate this loss from the original, resolving the similarity failure.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scaled_adv = sigmoid(advantage_gap)
adjusted_margin = margin * scaled_adv
losses = -log(sigmoid(adjusted_margin))
weighted_losses = weight * losses
max_val = max(weighted_losses)
stabilized = weighted_losses - max_val
sum_exp = sum(exp(stabilized))
sum_weights = sum(weight)
loss = max_val + log(sum_exp) - log(sum_weights)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    if weight is None:
        weight = ops.ones_like(lpw)
    scaled_adv = ops.sigmoid(adv)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    adjusted_margin = ops.mul(margin, scaled_adv)
    losses = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(adjusted_margin))
    weighted_losses = ops.mul(weight, losses)
    max_val = ops.max(weighted_losses)
    stabilized = ops.sub(weighted_losses, max_val)
    sum_exp = ops.sum(ops.exp(stabilized))
    sum_weights = ops.sum(weight)
    loss = ops.add(max_val, ops.sub(ops.log(sum_exp), ops.log(sum_weights)))
    return loss
